entries.descriptionSearch:
The Krusty Krab is in trouble, and it needs YOU to keep its doors open! Do you have what it takes to Save the Krusty Krab? 🍔

🧽 You’re hired! Play as SpongeBob, Patrick, Squidward, and more iconic characters from Bikini Bottom!

⏰ Clock in and get to work! Run the register, fire up the grill, assemble orders, and deliver food!
💰 Serve up iconic dishes, keep your customers happy, and bring in the MONEY!
⭐ Serve a large variety of customers, including villains, MVPs, and plenty of familiar faces!

entries.descriptionSearch:
🦕 Welcome to Ride A Dino! 🌋

How to Play:
🏇 Leap onto a stampeding dinosaur and ride the canyon
💪 Train on the Dino Machines to build up your Grip
🌋 Race through 9 wild eras: Plains, Desert, Jungle, Snow, Volcano and more
🦴 Tame and collect 50+ species, from Common all the way up to Divine
🏡 Bring them home to your ranch; upgrade pens and earn cash while you ride
✨ Hunt for Secret Dinos that only show up once in a while

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
